svg.desc: Four ranks in a ring, each sending to its neighbour. A ring all-reduce is a reduce-scatter of N minus 1 steps followed by an all-gather of N minus 1 steps, each step sending one chunk of size M over N, so each rank sends 2(N-1)/N times M bytes.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each rank talks only to its neighbour; per-rank traffic barely grows with N.
